PC02-001.name: Chocodra-Ange
PC02-001.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Cloud Contract/Incarnate, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Your counter +1. Then, you can return an "Incarnate" family Magic card from the Trash to your Hand.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Incarnate" family Spirit/Ultimate makes the first attack/block of the turn, during this turn, you can give every opposing Spirit/Ultimate -5000 BP, and destroy any target that reaches BP 0.

PC02-002.name: Chocodra-Lucife
PC02-002.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Cloud Contract/Incarnate & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can draw two cards from the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Incarnate" family Spirit/Ultimate makes the first attack/block of the turn, during this turn, the effects of every opposing Nexus/Grandwalker Nexus can't activate.

PC02-X01.name: Chocodra-the-Morning-Star
PC02-X01.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Cloud Contract/Incarnate & C5 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, for every two counters you have, during this turn, an opposing Spirit can't attack/block.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] Flash- (When Attacks)
Once per turn, return every opposing Spirit under the effect of "can't block" effects to the deckbottom. If there is any "Choco" among this Spirit's pre-advent cards, for each Spirit returned by this effect, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. (Max. 3)

PC02-CX01.name: Chocola (Card)
PC02-CX01.effect:
While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Soul State][Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2]
(Once per turn: Same Name) When your counter increases via your "Incarnate" family effects, you can draw a card.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, during this turn, you can give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -6000 BP, and destroy it when its brought to 0 BP.
